title: Prepare M4 human cutover decision package and reconcile documentary integrity
objective: Prepare the M4 human cutover decision package, verify documentary and source-level rollback readiness reproducibly, reconcile current criterion-layer version references to 1.1.1, register the known general-validator array-delta crash without repairing it, and prepare a non-executable M5 authorization proposal and brief without activating or modifying selector, registry, runtime or integrations.
required_outputs: M4 CUTOVER_DECISION_PACKAGE with no selected option.
M4 ROLLBACK_READINESS with bounded claim classification.
M4 bounded validator and validation results.
PEND-LAB-037 for the actual human cutover decision.
Evidence, registry delta, changed-files manifest, state, roadmap and continuity reconciliation.

cutover_decision_options.effect: Allows Jonathan to separately grant authorization 160; does not itself execute M5.
Keeps static selector authoritative and shadow registry inactive.
Closes migration without activating the shadow registry.
Requires a separately authorized remediation before another M4 decision.

acceptance_checks: All JSON parses and duplicate-key checks pass.
M4 artifacts exist under the authorized output root.
Cutover decision package contains no selected or inferred human decision.
M3 remediated result remains exact PASS with 420/420 equivalence.
No selector, registry, adapter or M3 artifact changed.
All current non-archive criterion-layer version references resolve to 1.1.1.
Archive and history references remain unchanged.
ERR-LAB-008 is registered and clearly marked not repaired.
Authorization 160 is PROPOSED and has no authority effect.
PEND-LAB-036 is completed and PEND-LAB-037 awaits Jonathan's cutover decision.
No runtime, integration, cutover, cloud or external repository effect.
stop_conditions: The live remote HEAD differs from the verified stage_1_head before stage 2.
DEC-LAB-025 or authorization 159 is missing or not GRANTED.
Codex is unavailable or a different technical executor would be used.
Any required change would modify selector behavior, shadow registry, M2 adapters or M3 evidence.
Rollback readiness cannot be bounded to documentary and source-level evidence.
A current version reference cannot be distinguished from archive or history.
The general validator error cannot be registered without repairing it.
Authorization 160 would become executable or granted.
Any action would create runtime, integration, cutover, cloud or external repository effects.
